setup: You are writing the equation of a line in the form y = mx + c.

steps.say: In y = mx + c the m is the gradient and the c is the y-intercept — the point where the line crosses the y-axis, which is the value of y when x is 0.
The gradient goes in front of x and the intercept goes at the end.
Substituting gives y = ([[m_num]]/[[m_den]])x + [[b]], which simplifies to [[equation]].
